resources.string: Let the Agent run another app on an independent virtual display and read its screen.

Requires Shizuku in ADB shell mode. Once authorized, the Agent can create a display automatically and removes it when the task ends. Supports observation, app launch, tap, swipe, Back, and direct text replacement on the secondary display.
Install Shizuku and start its service with wireless debugging or ADB.
Start the Shizuku service in ADB mode.
Shizuku is running. Authorize Gimi before the Agent can use a virtual display.
Allow Gimi in Shizuku’s authorized apps.
This feature requires Shizuku ADB shell mode. Restart it with ADB.
The Agent can create a separate display matching the current device size during a task.
Accessibility is enabled. Supported fields on the secondary display can receive text directly.
Enable Accessibility for direct input. If direct text replacement is unavailable, the operation stops without invoking an input method.
Another Agent task currently owns the display.
Display creation or isolation verification failed.
